winner.hypothesis: Adding an outer non-structural skip to LineIndex.build (src/indexer/lineIndex.ts, outside-string path just before `const b = buf[i];` at L283) that, driven by a module-level Uint8Array(256) class table WCLS marking only '"' '{' '[' '}' ']' '\n' ' ' '\t' '\r' as 1, advances i over every run of class-0 bytes in one tight do/while (setting lineHasContent = true once per run) will raise the primary speedup from ~1.50 to ~1.62-1.68, because on top of the round-2 string loop the outside-string bytes are now a large share of cost and every class-0 byte currently pays a full outer iteration + inString test + switch dispatch only to set lineHasContent = true. Unlike round 2's failed skipLHC it is not gated on lineHasContent and whitespace is folded into the table, so it skips digits/true/false/null/':'/',' runs everywhere with no extra guard. This is the only change: the string branch, the switch cases, checkpoint modulo, record pushes, for-await loop, Buffer.from conversion and EOF handling are untouched.
